text.content: ORDERED 2026-07-12 — 4 units @ 2,52 € (total 13,72 € incl. shipping) from HNX DIY Electronic Store (AliExpress), order ref 3074709294175683. Expected ~2026-07-22. Steering-angle deploy sensor (rear mount). WHY THIS SENSOR: (1, fundamental) single-wire PWM output — we never got the AS5600 to output PWM (dead OUT pin), and its I2C doesn't survive the ~1.2 m run to the rear PCB. (2) it reads a strong, roughly-homogeneous field from big magnets at a distance better than the AS5600 (which needs a small magnet centered over the chip), so it suits the kart's big-magnet setup better — an improvement, not a magnet risk. Bench-validate the PWM path on arrival (runbook). MA732 dropped (MT6701 covers both magnet tolerance and PWM, cheaper and in hand).

text.content:
Magnetic rotary angle sensor MODULE (ready breakout board, not a bare chip). 14-bit, board form ~2.3x2.3 cm, interfaces: I2C, SPI/SSI, ABZ quadrature, UVW, analog, and PWM. SimpleFOC ecosystem; ESP32 drivers exist. Module PCB variants (-22 vs -42): same MT6701 chip and same output modes; the suffix is board form-factor / pin layout only. Default factory mode is ABZ (1024-line quadrature); I2C/SSI reads the 14-bit absolute angle, PWM gives absolute angle as duty.

Bring-up runbook: dv/kart/steering/mt6701-pwm-bringup-runbook.md. SimpleFOC thread: https://community.simplefoc.com/t/mt6701-magnetic-position-encoder-support/2618

text.content: Triple Schmitt-trigger buffer (Y = A, three independent channels). VCC 1.65-5.5 V; inputs are over-voltage tolerant and accept up to 5.5 V regardless of VCC, so it level-shifts 5 V signals down to 3V3 when powered from 3V3. Used as U5 on the kart-medulla schematic to bring the three 5 V motor Hall signals down to 3V3 for the ESP32-S3. Ordered from Mouser, not yet delivered (as of 2026-07-08). TI product page: https://www.ti.com/product/SN74LVC3G17
